course_name_original: SDM3 — PROPRIETES PHYSIQUES DES MATERIAUX DE METHODOLOGIE DE CHOIX (46 h)
course_name_en: SDM3 — PHYSICAL PROPERTIES OF MATERIALS AND SELECTION METHODOLOGY (46 h)
syllabus_topics: Lattice heat (Einstein and Debye models of heat capacity, phonons, Fourier's laws for diffusion, thermal radiation, thermal conductivity)
Electrical conduction in metals and semiconductors (free electron gas model, band theory, doping, Hall effect)
TP on thermal conductivity of different materials
TP on heat diffusion in a steel rod
TP on variations of heat capacity of elementary materials with temperature
Ashby method for material selection: objective functions and performance indices, geometric shape factor
TP using specialized software for material selection during object design
Introduction to photo-lithography - Resolution limits and main processes of photoresists
Collective microfabrication methods, different photolithographies. Examples of devices. Notions on chemical machining of metals, silicon by wet etching, principles of plasma etching. Technique

assessment_methods.method: TP average (for Physical Properties of Materials)

assessment_rules: For 'Propriétés physiques des matériaux', the evaluation is based on two partial exams and the average of the practical work (TP), each counting for 1/3 of the final grade. For 'Microtechniques', the evaluation consists of a partial exam (2/3) and a TP report or QCM (1/3).
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
